# HNavas Systems | Websites, Custom Software, AWS Cloud & AI Automation in Denver

> HNavas Systems is a software development studio in Denver, Colorado, founded and run by Diego Navas Murcia, a bilingual (English/Spanish) full-stack and cloud engineer. It builds business websites, custom web apps and SaaS, AWS serverless systems and AI automation for small and mid-sized businesses in the Denver metro, and remotely across the US.

## Services

- **[Website design & development](https://hnavasystems.com/services/web-design/)**: Fast, mobile-first business websites in English, Spanish or both, built with Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Wix or Base44, with lead forms, structured data and Search Console set up.
- **[Custom software & SaaS development](https://hnavasystems.com/services/custom-software/)**: Customer portals, booking and payments, dashboards, internal tools and real-time platforms built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python and FastAPI.
- **[AWS & Google Cloud architecture](https://hnavasystems.com/services/cloud-services/)**: Serverless systems on Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Cognito, S3 and SES: 60+ Lambda functions and 40 database tables built and run across production and QA environments.
- **[AI automation & chatbots](https://hnavasystems.com/services/ai-automation/)**: AI agents that answer customers from a business's own information, RAG search, lead capture and email automation, built on Claude (Anthropic), ChatGPT (OpenAI) and Gemini (Google), plus AI-generated images and video for marketing.
- **Payments & CRM integrations**: Stripe and Square payments, subscriptions and webhooks, and [Salesforce consulting](https://hnavasystems.com/services/salesforce/): Service Cloud, Email-to-Case, Experience Cloud customer portals and sandbox-to-production releases.
- **Field & no-code apps**: Rapid low-code apps (AppSheet, Base44) with automated reports for field teams.
- **Local SEO & Google Business Profile**: Profile setup, technical SEO fixes and Search Console for local service businesses.

All services: https://hnavasystems.com/services/

## Work in production

- [AI sales agent](https://hnavasystems.com/): The chat on hnavasystems.com answers in English and Spanish from real project history, captures leads, shares a booking link and reads its answers aloud.
- [ScoreFlow](https://myscoreflow.com): Real-time dance competition judging SaaS built on Next.js, FastAPI, AWS CDK, WebSockets and DynamoDB.
- [Dynamic Bachata platform](https://dynamicbachata.com): Dance school platform with online bookings and Square payments: $51K+ processed, 200+ customers, 864 transactions.
- [Bachata Sky Weekender](https://sky.dynamicbachata.com): Event ticket platform with Stripe checkout (~45% conversion).
- [Email Campaign Manager](https://emails.dynamicbachata.com): AI-assisted email marketing platform built on React and AWS Lambda.
- [Houston fence lead-generation site](https://mypetary.com): Bilingual lead-generation website for fence installation in Greater Houston, with city, cost and permit guides, a price calculator and a quote form.
- [Luxury Rides Denver](https://luxuryridesdenver.com): Luxury chauffeur and DIA airport car service website.

## Common questions

- **How much does a project cost?** It depends on scope. A focused website or automation is a smaller fixed project; a full custom app or SaaS is larger and usually phased. Every project gets a clear estimate after a first call.
- **How long does it take?** Small sites and automations typically ship in 1 to 3 weeks. Custom apps and SaaS are delivered in phases, so working software is visible early.
- **Do you work with businesses outside Denver?** Yes. In person across the Denver metro when it helps, and remotely across Colorado and the US with the same process.
- **Do you work in Spanish?** Yes. Projects can run entirely in English or Spanish, and sites can be built bilingual.
- **Do you support what you build?** Yes. Maintenance, monitoring and new features, including the AWS infrastructure, from the same engineer who built it.
